Human Annotation vs LLM Annotation. ## How LLM-as-a-Judge Is Transforming Data Annotation Beyond Manual Human Labeling. Data annotation is the process of assigning meaningful identifiers to raw data, such as images, text, or videos, to improve the understanding of models by machine learning algorithms. This method uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to evaluate and generate annotations, so automating parts of the annotation process. So, we have seen “LLM-as-Judge” approach has improved data annotation for Large Language Models (LLMs). ## Technical Comparison of Human vs LLM Annotation: Accuracy, Consistency, Scalability, and Cost. It is important to evaluate the consistency and accuracy of data annotation techniques in order to construct reliable AI systems. It’s important to evaluate the scale and cost-effectiveness when comparing human annotation to methods that use Large Language Models (LLMs).
